raw_text: Thread on Indian Chronicles and what it tells us about the evolution of state-adjacent influence operations. The EU DisinfoLab findings show a 15-year operation involving 750+ fake outlets across 116 countries. Key distinction: unlike Russian IRA-style ops that create fictional personas, this network primarily resurrected dead media brands and impersonated defunct news agencies. This made detection harder because the names had legitimate historical provenance. The network also created shell NGOs that gained UN ECOSOC consultative status, allowing them to submit statements at UNHRC sessions. This is influence operations at the institutional level, not just social media manipulation. The sophistication is remarkable regardless of one's political perspective.
